status: exploratory, not pre-registered; does not change the H3 decision. Titration labels are this analysis's own definitions, not the project lead's.

settings.cv: notebook cv_predict: StandardScaler on all rows, GroupKFold(5) by stay_id
settings.bootstrap: paired patient bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 42, identical rows (h3_paired_bootstrap.paired_cluster_bootstrap restrict=True)
settings.offset_mode: bins (features at t, label of the on-at-tau row at t + k)
settings.row_set: rows with any of the six label drugs running at tau (start <= tau < end)
settings.labels: one-vs-rest on the on-at-tau rows; see the script docstring
settings.nee: Goradia 2021: NE + epi + phenylephrine/10 + dopamine/100 + vasopressin(U/min)*2.5; dobutamine excluded; 5 levels (0, quartiles of nonzero)
